newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 3.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 3.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Thursday:
* On Wednesday, the Dow Jones rose by 29.07 points to 5,933.97. PLDT's ADR fell by $ 1/8 to $62 7/8.
* The peso closed at 26.246 to a U.S.dollar from 26.242.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,171.88, down 18.1 points.
* The Philippine interbank call loan rate rose to 12.46875 percent from 12.15625.

* Stock brokerage Sun Hung Kai Securities said the market will be trading sideways on Wednesday with investors focusing on the release of September inflation data later in the week. Local investors will be concentrating on selective small-cap stocks for the time being.

Sun Hung Kai said Wednesday's major gainer Philrealty (+7.14%) had risen on talk that it will sell part of its stake in Philippine Racing Club at a substantial profit. It said La Tondena (+6.12%) had risen on talk of a private placement in the offing.

* Brokerage Philippine Asia Equity Securities Inc said: "We will probably continue to see some weakness in share prices until the general sentiment takes a huge turn. The announcement of September inflation should do the trick ..."

* Brokerage BPI Securities recommended a "Buy for 1997" on Universal Rightfield Property Holdings Inc which has applied to incorporate a new subsidiary Universal Leisure Corp to develop and possibly market the product. Demand for the shares is expected to be high and contribution to the firm's income should be seen in 1997, BPI Securities said.

* The Manila Chronicle quoted oil industry officials as saying prices of diesel and liquified petroleum gas are expected to rise again by October 12, pushed up by the increasing demand for fuel in the U.S. and Europe as winter sets in.
